required_plan: A customer-owned AWS account with CloudFormation, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, SQS, EventBridge Scheduler, Secrets Manager, SNS, and CloudWatch access.

atomic_store.notes: DynamoDB transactions atomically commit message, recipient ledger, idempotency claim, outbox item, and backlog counter.

recipient_ledger.notes: DynamoDB stores provider-neutral message, recipient, attempt, immutable provider event, and outbox records.

payload_store.notes: Private encrypted S3 stores bodies and attachments outside the DynamoDB item-size boundary.

queue_wakeup.notes: SQS publishes deterministic at-least-once jobs; duplicate delivery is absorbed by leases and final-state checks.

scheduler_wakeup.notes: SQS handles short delays and EventBridge Scheduler creates self-deleting one-time wakes for later sends.

periodic_reconciliation.notes: A one-minute dispatcher sweep recovers committed due rows after queue or scheduler wake-up loss.

secret_injection.notes: Secrets Manager supplies the bootstrap secret only to the API runtime that requires it.

provider_event_ingress.notes: SES configuration-set events enter through SNS and are normalized before ledger mutation.

webhook_egress.notes: SQS-backed webhook jobs use stable event IDs and privacy-safe bounded retries.

backup_restore.notes: DynamoDB point-in-time recovery protects metadata; payload retention and a complete restore drill remain deployment-policy responsibilities.

safe_deploy.notes: The CLI creates a reviewed CloudFormation changeset and refuses an unexpected account or unsafe integration target.

doctor.notes: Doctor verifies identity, runtime health, queue recovery, capability metadata, and authenticated API behavior.

upgrade.notes: CloudFormation changesets update the stack while retaining provider-neutral records.

rollback.notes: CloudFormation rollback is supported; operators must validate data migrations and recovery procedures for the exact release.

cleanup.notes: The disposable integration workflow deletes the stack and verifies the run-scoped resource set is absent.

limitations: Production readiness remains false until the exact-main SES terminal-delivery and controlled-receipt proof in issue #126 passes.
A complete backup and restore drill must cover both DynamoDB metadata and retained S3 payloads.
The customer remains responsible for AWS account, Region, quota, budget, and retention policy.
